policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

protocol.evidence: A fresh StatePolicyRZDT1 research run acquires 32 real vector observations. The next 12 actual optimizer calls still use StatePolicyRZDT1, then all remaining calls use the existing RZDT2 simulator. The adoption policy sees only paired pre-measurement predictions, the measured target and noise estimate; no mechanism label is supplied.
protocol.scope: One preselected new seed, frozen policy and thresholds, no tuning after results. This is a functional mechanism-change case, not a performance comparison. Final truth scoring uses the final RZDT2 mechanism after the recommendation freezes.
